data.rationale: Union Bank shows strong momentum with improved asset quality (GNPA at 3.06%, PCR at 95.13%) and credit cost at just 0.09%. Loan growth projected at 11.5-14% driven by RAM segment guidance of 11.50% YoY, branch expansion of 200 branches, and retail/MSME focus. NIM expected to gradually improve from 2.76% to 3.00% as CASA ratio improves from current 33.96% to 41% through liability repricing and deposit franchise strengthening. Credit cost normalized to 15-30 bps from unsustainably low 9 bps as one-time recovery benefits taper. Cost-to-income improvement from operational efficiency and scale benefits. Strong capital position (CAR 16.49%, CET-I 13.94%) supports growth without dilution. ROE sustains above 17% with ROA improving to 1.6% as asset quality stabilizes and operating leverage improves. Conservative assumptions reflect PSU bank execution risk despite strong recent performance.
